focus_tree = {
	id = modded_tree

	# Mod-specific tree-level block the editor knows nothing about.
	kaiserreich_metadata = {
		branch = syndicalist
		author = "someone { with } braces in their name"
		weights = { 1 2 3 }
	}

	focus = {
		id = modded_focus
		x = 0
		y = 0
		cost = 10

		# Unknown blocks: must survive in raw, be listed as unparsed, and be
		# absent from clean_raw.
		custom_mod_effect = {
			do_something_odd = yes
			nested = { deeper = { deepest = 1 } }
		}

		dynamic_modifier_block = {
			modifier = custom_thing
		}

		# Known blocks around them must still map normally.
		available = {
			has_completed_focus = modded_prereq
		}

		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 50
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = modded_prereq
		x = 2
		y = 0
		cost = 10
	}

	# Anonymous values inside a block, plus a bare nested block.
	editor_hints = {
		collapsed
		pinned
		{ 1 2 }
	}
}
